definitions.explanation: Hair that is silver or gray in color. Can describe naturally grayed hair in an elegant or positive way, or silver-colored hair in fiction and character descriptions.

examples.japanese: {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧きた。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{銀髪|ぎんぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has beautiful silver hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銀髪|ぎんぱつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧な⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧だ。
examples.english: The protagonist of that movie has a striking appearance with silver hair and red eyes.

notes:
{銀髪|ぎんぱつ} means silver or gray hair, with a more elegant or attractive connotation than ⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧. Combines ⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧ (silver) + {髪|はつ} (hair).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧ (silver-haired gentleman)
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{銀髪|ぎんぱつ} (beautiful silver hair)
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧ (silver-haired character)
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧ (to dye hair silver)

USAGE:
{銀髪|ぎんぱつ} portrays gray hair positively — as distinguished, elegant, or stylish. In contrast, ⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧ is neutral or sometimes carries negative associations with aging.

POP CULTURE:
Very common in anime and manga character descriptions, where {銀髪|ぎんぱつ} characters are a popular archetype. Often paired with distinctive eye colors.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧: white/gray hair (neutral, aging-related)
- ⟦{金髪|きんぱつ}→金髪：14443_kinpatsu⟧: blond hair
- ⟦{黒髪|くろかみ}→黒髪：20251_kurokami⟧: black hair
- ⟦{茶髪|ちゃぱつ}→茶髪：14203_chapatsu⟧: brown-dyed hair
